build.comment: frontendDist points at the react-native-web export built WITHOUT a baseUrl (root-relative assets) so it loads from the tauri:// origin. beforeBuildCommand runs the export; run it manually with `npm run build:web` during development.

security.comment: csp null keeps the packaged web app's inline styles / connections working. The RNW build talks to the same chat.globalbr.ai API + socket as the browser build; tighten this to an allowlist before a public release.
